item.title: Romulus City Council unanimously approves resolution against planned ICE facility
item.description: The Romulus City Council unanimously approved a resolution that opposes the operation of an ICE facility in the city limits. Just before 8 p.m. on Monday, city council members voted on the resolution, citing several financial, moral and possibly legal complications. This would include decreased property values and zoning ordinances.
